mission: Enable microbial activation of dietary polyphenols into bioactive metabolites.

stage2a.operation: Assess the existing ellagic-acid/urolithin pathway only; do not generalise across all polyphenols. Production of downstream metabolites and their efficacy belong to distinct claims.

existing_findings.proposition: Ellagic acid conversion requires microbial activity; particular species perform intermediate steps, and human completion varies.

stage2a.evidence_enrichment: Pure-culture intermediate formation and variable human urolithin exposure are distinct. Downstream administered-urolithin experiments do not establish food-driven mitochondrial, cognitive or ADHD effects.

source_to_claim_records.proposition: Gordonibacter cultures produced intermediate urolithins from ellagic acid.
source_to_claim_records.limitation: Pure strains did not produce final urolithin A/B; community completion is conditional.

source_to_claim_records.proposition: Assayed pomegranate juice contained ellagic acid/punicalagins; urolithin exposure varied across people.
source_to_claim_records.limitation: Commercial juice matrix; not equivalent to whole pomegranate or walnuts, predictable urolithin yield, mitochondrial or brain benefit.
source_to_claim_records.retrieval: Primary full text, investigational product assays and conversion results.

stage2a.coverage_limitations: Existing source assessments and full attached bibliography are inventoried and preserved. Targeted source retrieval is bounded to the stated propositions; unrefreshed clinical/Phenome sources are not newly validated. No evidence of absence is inferred.
stage2a.stop_rationale: Preserve the complete baseline, add the bounded supported evidence and exact qualifications, and park material attribution/traceability questions for approval instead of forcing an admission or expanding to a comprehensive rebuild.
